visual_logic: Highlights the deep, toothless, strongly pointed beak tip of Tupandactylus positioned just below its iconic massive crest foundation.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of the open, toothless jaws of a Tupandactylus, viewed from a direct three quarter view perspective, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized edges. The short, incredibly deep jaw frame opens wide around an empty mouth cavity, ending in a sharp downward-pointing tip. The smooth cutting margins are clad in a matte keratin sheath with vibrant gradients of electric blue and neon orange. At the base of the jaw, the stylized head features a massive rising crest foundation and large, highly expressive cartoon eyes looking toward the viewer. The asset is perfectly centered in a 1:1 square composition, maintaining a strict 25% negative space safety margin. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with deep contact shadows. Illuminated by soft studio lighting.
